title: The Kaiju Preservation Society
author: John Scalzi
summary: Jamie Gray loses a job and takes a delivery gig with a mysterious outfit that turns out to look after enormous creatures in a hidden world. It is a quick, lighthearted monster adventure with a team of scientists.
readIf: you want a short, breezy science-fiction romp with big creatures and banter.
skipIf: you want deep characters or a serious, scientific treatment of its premise.

pairings.reason: More fast, funny Scalzi, this time making fun of television space adventures.
A science-first adventure that keeps its warmth, with a larger emotional payoff.
The classic story of people facing giant creatures, with a much more serious tone.
